What is real here

Real answers. No real bookings.

Every reply is generated live from only the details you enter. When it does not know something, it says so and takes a message instead of guessing.

Nothing is booked, texted or emailed. SignalWire processes typed dialogue or microphone audio to answer you; calls are not recorded. Your call record stays in this tab. Browser voice calls end after three minutes. Typing works without microphone access.

In production the same receptionist answers your actual phone number and writes to your actual calendar.
